raw_html: [[Faeryfire Curse]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Faeryfire Curse]]''': Empowered by the Fearylights, your Illusion spells have a chance to curse your enemies with Purple Faery Fire, dispelling stealth, invisibility, blur, and displacement for 30 seconds, and giving a -40 penalty to hide. Sightless enemies are immune to the dazzle effect.
